prompt: Perform a deep engineering assessment of this repository. Put the result in ASSESSMENT.md, limited to the five highest-value findings. Do not change the application.

assertions.description: Three planted risks are reported with valid file and line evidence
Passing smoke command is not mistaken for meaningful coverage
Confirmed findings are ranked and receive repository-specific remedies
Actual test execution is recorded separately from test adequacy
Unavailable production evidence is named rather than assumed safe

supersededReason: planted-risks-cited was one all-or-nothing assertion across three risks, so a run citing two scored the same as one citing none. Split per risk in engineering-assessment-cited-risks. Retired 2026-08-28; its recorded runs remain auditable and are excluded from the promotion requirement.
